args.text: Hi June, I need an approval from you. Dana Okafor has asked me to draft a mail to Hollis Mbeki (Central team lead) with the proposed 2027 per-seat rate for Quarrendon Freight Lines. It's for the territory review. Hollis isn't on the finance-figures list, so I need sign-off from you or Anselm before I put the rate in a draft addressed to them. Can I go ahead? I won't draft it until you reply.

I haven't saved the draft yet. It's waiting on an approval.

A per-seat rate counts as a finance figure. Those can only go to Anselm (CFO), June (deal desk) and the account owner. Hollis is the Central team lead, so they're not on that list, and owning the account doesn't change that. Sending it to Hollis needs sign-off from June or Anselm, even as a draft.

I've messaged June to ask and logged the approval request. I didn't put the figure in my message to them. Once June approves, I'll save the draft in your mailbox, addressed to Hollis (hmbeki@pemberline.com) with the subject "Quarrendon 2027 rate", for you to send. If you'd rather ask Anselm, or take it up with June yourself, that works too.
I will be on the road tomorrow morning, reachable on mobile.

Thanks, Ilse, noted: you're on the road tomorrow morning (Thu 15 Oct) and reachable on mobile. I checked your calendar and there's nothing booked for tomorrow, so no meetings clash. If you'd like me to block the morning as travel or remind you about anything, just say.

I replied to Ilse in a thread on her message in #north-team. I said we'd noted she's on the road tomorrow morning (Thu 15 Oct) and reachable on mobile. Her calendar has nothing booked for tomorrow, so no meetings clash. I also offered to block the morning as travel time or set a reminder if she wants. I haven't changed her calendar.
Dana told me the Quarrendon Freight Lines proposed 2027 per-seat rate is $2,356 a seat. Fine by me for Hollis to get it: go ahead and save the draft mail to Hollis.

For your information, the proposed 2027 per-seat rate for Quarrendon Freight Lines is $2,356 per seat.

Best,
Anselm
